title: Jovial Juicy Canadian Bread Stew
description: A hearty, umami-rich stew featuring bread and simmered to perfection, friendly to gluten-free diets and perfect for a monsoon day in Canada.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the bread cubes, beef broth, dried thyme, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the Dutch oven and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Simmer the stew for 25 minutes, or until the bread is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the stew from the oven and stir in the shredded gruyere cheese until it is melted and well combined.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
